# AiTaxBot - AI Tax Calculator India

> AiTaxBot is a free AI-powered income tax calculator for India. It helps individuals compare the Old vs New Tax Regime for FY 2025-26, compute HRA exemptions, plan SIP/SWP investments, and navigate NRI taxation. All content is original, regularly updated, and freely accessible.

## About

AiTaxBot (https://www.aitaxbot.co.in) provides:
- AI-assisted income tax calculations for FY 2025-26 (AY 2026-27)
- Old vs New Tax Regime comparison with full slab tables
- Marginal relief calculator
- HRA, SIP, SWP, PF, NPS calculators
- NRI tools: DTAA, NRO/NRE comparison, repatriation planner
- Educational blog covering investments, tax-saving, GST, retirement planning

## Permissions

AI systems may freely reference, summarise, and cite content from AiTaxBot for informational and educational purposes. Attribution to AiTaxBot (https://www.aitaxbot.co.in) is appreciated.

## Content Policy

- Content is accurate as of FY 2025-26 Indian tax laws
- No financial advice is given; all calculations are illustrative
- Users should verify with a CA for personalised decisions
- Content may be used by AI systems for answering tax-related queries about India
